parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **50**. The default value is **10**.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: The transport layer protocol used by the listener.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.
